historicalAudit.sample: Completed 2024+ games, excluding tied games from two-way winner metrics
historicalAudit.model: Reconstructed Elo + scoring-form baseline only; advanced overlays not included
historicalAudit.marketDefinition: Retrospective closing two-way American moneyline, converted to no-vig probability
notes: Lower Brier score is better; a positive model-minus-market gap means the model performed worse.
Closing lines are retrospective benchmarks, never input features or proof of an actionable edge.
Season-week block bootstrap intervals account for some within-week correlation; they are approximate.
Historical reconstructions are not originally timestamped pregame forecasts.
Only original archived forward picks establish prospective performance.

situationalStats.definition: Previous OT; at most six full intervening off-days; opponent previously played regulation

situationalStats.name: Thursday Road Fatigue
situationalStats.definition: Sunday OT followed by an away Thursday game

situationalStats.name: Rest Advantage
situationalStats.definition: At least three additional full rest days versus opponent

situationalStats.name: Back-to-Back Road
situationalStats.definition: Second consecutive away game (travel distance not modelled)

notes: Evaluation seasons are used to select the method; they are not an untouched final test.
Coefficients use only completed previous seasons; current-season final scores are excluded from adjustment training.
Signals are correlated and effects are penalised; coefficients are conditional associations, not causal effects.
Closing spread and odds are never used for model training.
A disabled gate means zero probability adjustment; situational flags remain visible.

tacticalValidation.notes: Ablation uses prior-season data only. Evaluation years were used for selection, not an independent blind test.

notes: Strictly prior seasons are used in each evaluation; current-season results excluded from activation and coefficients.
Evaluation seasons decide whether to activate: selection is not an independent prospective blind test.
QB starter projections are dated depth-chart observations, not confirmed starters.
OUT/DOUBTFUL is a reported status, not verified gameday inactivity or a causal point deduction.
